Controversy Over Virat Kohli's Visit to Premanand Maharaj's Ashram

Virat Kohli visited Premanand Maharaj’s ashram amid allegations that a disciple died, other people went missing, and that he was paid to make the visit; Kohli later broke his silence on the issue, and a spokesperson for Premanand Maharaj denied that any money was given to Kohli.
